reviewer: fresh-context arch review subagent (general-purpose), two passes: full review, then verification of the fixes
scope: ADR-0105: the SessionStart sync nudge also fires on a stale global skill mirror at an unchanged version. The skill fingerprint and drift rule were extracted from esk-init.mjs into .claude/skills/bootstrap/scripts/skill-signature.mjs (signatureOf, mirrorDrift, skillNamesIn, SKILL_MIRROR_SKIP), now used by esk-init --check (assess), esk-init --yes (planSkills), and the emitter. emit-directive.mjs loads it by a best-effort dynamic import with a 2 s budget; sync-nudge.mjs decideNudge takes driftedSkills (null = not assessed) and skillsTarget. Plus unit and emitter tests, five BDD scenarios with a step file, the regenerated BDD index, the coverage log entry, and ADR-0105. The first pass raised 5 findings (3 medium, 2 low); the second pass confirmed all 5 fixed and raised 2 more lows; both were fixed before this entry and pinned by tests.
